text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Victoire Pisa got injured,
I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making you worry...
But I'm all right now.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Now that the treatment is finished,
let us return to training right away.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I cannot afford to disrupt
the training regimen that Trainer
has put together for me.
choice_data_list: I can rework the schedule as many times as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: However, it seems they went through quite a struggle to settle on this menu...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, the injury was only minor, and I wouldn't want to trouble you any further, Trainer.
choice_data_list: ...I just want you to not push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, the injury was only minor, and I wouldn't want to trouble you any further, Trainer.
choice_data_list: ...I just want you to not push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Still, if we do that, Trainer will...!
choice_data_list: Dealing with the unexpected is part of the job, too.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... That was presumptuous of me.
When no one cares more deeply about the Umamusume than you do...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Understood. I will make sure to get plenty of rest now so that I don't fall behind any further.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after making her promise to tell me immediately if it hurt,
we returned to training, but—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, if I move any more than this, I'll probably...
choice_data_list: ! I'll take you to the infirmary right away!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes... I am truly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Victoire Pisa's injury worsened,
I decided to have her take a break
and rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after making her promise to tell me immediately if it hurt,
we returned to training—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, yeah. Looks like she's okay.
Thank goodness it wasn't a serious injury.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I can't cause any more trouble for Trainer.
Carefully, very carefully..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not pushing too hard paid off,
and she successfully overcame her injury.
